rationale: The stakeholders have aligned on the need for a negotiated, durable restructuring, but the core dispute remains unresolved: labor and public stakeholders insist on no closures/no compulsory redundancies and strong guarantees, while management, owners, and investors still require structural cost and capacity reductions and will not accept blanket protections without material economic change. There is movement toward a bargaining framework, but not enough substantive convergence to end the simulation.
